name: Card Deal
description: The second clip is dealt onto the frame like a hand of cards: tile after tile is flicked from below the frame, spinning through the air with a lifting shadow, and slides to a stop in its place until the picture is complete. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: deck
params.description: Point the cards are dealt from, can be outside the frame (0..1, y down)

params.name: spin
params.description: Turns a card makes on its way, before it settles straight

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows the cards cast
